question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**support**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the importance of work in human life and how everyone needs to labor in some way.
 
• Blank number 2 refers to what males do with their labor, so the verb should indicate sustaining or maintaining oneself.
 
• "**Support**" fits perfectly as it means to provide for oneself or maintain oneself, aligning with the context of labor.
 
• Other options ("**bear**", "**embrace**", "**promote**") do not correctly convey the meaning of self-sustenance.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
